text:
maya: FYI rolling TLS profile hardening to prod started at 02:00 UTC. ap-south first, then eu-west. This includes TLS1.3-only and a narrower cipher list.
dan: i patched OpenSSL at 01:40 for CVE-2026-9999, so that was in the canary. All good there.
owen: getting alerts from eu-west proxies: a cluster is failing cert unseal -> KMS decrypt errors concurrently with handshake drops.
maya: snippets from proxy logs (redacted):
```
2026-06-12T02:05:42Z proxy-eu-2 ERROR mTLS: cert unseal failed: kms:Decrypt AccessDenied for key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/rot-2025
  at keystore.Unseal (rotator.go:210)
  at proxy/handshake (handshake.go:128)
```
lee: 403s from keystore-api: {"error":"forbidden","reason":"missing: kms:Decrypt"} across 12 nodes. But ap-south is fine.
ochris_s: did we rotate the KMS CMK alias recently? I recall a scheduled key rotation yesterday for eu-west.
own: yes, we rotated the CMK and tightened the key policy to limit decrypt to principal role:keystore-prod-eu. That role was supposed to be granted to the rotator.
dan: quick check: RBAC audit shows a role-binding change at 01:58 from `rbac-deploy` that removed `role/keystore-decrypter` from `svc-rotator-eu` for a short window during rollout. It was meant for staging only but applied to prod by mistake.
maya: ugh. So two coincident changes: OpenSSL upgrade + TLS profile + KMS rotation + an accidental prod RBAC change. Which broke decrypts?
own: decryption failures point to RBAC denial, not key material mismatch. AccessDenied in CloudTrail for kms:Decrypt from rotator service-account.
lee: mitigation options: A) restore role-binding for svc-rotator-eu (fast), B) attach a temporary policy to the CMK to allow decrypt to proxy principal, C) failover proxies to cached certs until fix. Best short term is A.
ochris_s: opening emergency revert PR now.
infra-bot: PR created by chris_s: https://git.internal/infra/rbac/pull/467 (re-add keystore decrypter binding). CI checks required.
oncall: infra-ops approve? :rotating_light: 
maya: also, can we scope a temporary monitoring rule to detect TLS handshakes failing with unseal errors vs normal TLS errors? We need faster triage next time.
dan: added temporary log filter `mTLS: cert unseal failed` and tagged events with `incident-1741000000` at 02:10 UTC.
owen: infra-ops approved revert at 02:12, binding restored 02:12:30. Observed decrypt success spikes at 02:12:55; handshake error rate went back to baseline by 02:15.
lee: mitigation success. Now for root cause: why did RBAC change hit prod?
maya: preliminary: the rbac-deploy pipeline had an env var mispointing to `environments/prod` alias during the rollout job. The change was intended for staging.
ochris_s: follow-up action items I propose: 1) enforce a staging/production protection in the pipeline requiring `--confirm-prod` flag and two approvers, 2) add a pre-deploy canary that runs a synthetic kms:Decrypt using the target principal and key per region, abort on failure, 3) add an allowlist on CMK policies for rotator/prx principals preventing accidental removal, 4) enrich console with fast filters for keystore KMS denies.
own: also recommend increasing audit retention for KMS and CloudTrail for 90 days for now — SOC requested the bundle.
soc-bot: SOC alerted via PD at 02:20, requested CloudTrail slice and timeline. Will coordinate.
dan: compliance note: we applied OpenSSL patch and tightened TLS; no evidence of key material exfiltration. All decrypt attempts denied, not successful.
maya: will file incident INC-2026-06121 and assign RCA: @chris_s for pipeline, @lee for rotator/keystore allowlist, @owen for monitoring+playbook.
chris_s: quick question: do we want the proxy to treat AccessDenied from KMS as 503 (transient) or 403 (auth)? If we mark 503 we might auto-retry which hides real RBAC issues. Thoughts?
lee: keep 403, but increase observability and raise an operator alert if >5% nodes in region see kms:Decrypt AccessDenied within 3m. Then auto-open revert PR for RBAC.
own: agree. Auto-revert must be gated: open PR + require infra-ops approval, but also page oncall.
maya: one more: TLS profile rollout had a config that disabled older cipher suites. That surfaced more handshakes during the outage because proxies retried cert unseal more aggressively under new handshake semantics. Let's add rollout slowdowns for security-critical changes.
dan: noted. Action item: add staged rollout with 5% -> 25% -> 100% and a 10-minute validation window for cert management metrics.
infra-bot: scheduled job `rbac-deploy` paused pending fixes until 2026-06-15T00:00Z.
oncall: closing thread, incident filed, RCA tasks created. Re-open if new signals appear. :white_check_mark:
